items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: I do remember hearing my daddy play, say that Charlie DeBurgis played with them.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Professor Mineta studied, took lessons from him. He did? He must have taught and played different instruments. He most had it.
When he was a boy... I do remember hearing my daddy play, say that Charlie DeBurgis played with them.
